name: The Cisco Kid
description: The Cisco Kid is a half-hour American Western television series starring Duncan Renaldo in the title role, The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carrillo as the jovial sidekick, Pancho. Cisco and Pancho were technically desperados, wanted for unspecified crimes, but instead viewed by the poor as Robin Hood figures who assisted the downtrodden when law enforcement officers proved corrupt or unwilling to help. It was also the first television series to be filmed in color, although few viewers saw it in color until the 1960s.

videos.title: Boomerang
videos.overview: Cisco and Poncho are being impersonated by two bandits who have committed robbery and murder, so they have to break jail to prove their innocence.

videos.title: Counterfeit Money
videos.overview: Cisco and Pancho are asked by Marshal Ben Lane to track down a gang of counterfeiters in Durado. Cisco suspects the local banker and his clerk to be involved in the counterfeit, but cannot prove anything. He sets some traps for the gang. One of the traps involves arresting Pancho as an alleged bank robber.

videos.title: Big Switch
videos.overview: Cisco's involved with a convict posing as a rancher. Cisco: Duncan Renaldo. Pancho: Leo Carrillo.

videos.title: Convict Story
videos.overview: A convict steals Pancho's clothes and horse. Pancho: Leo Carrillo. Cisco: Duncan Renaldo.

videos.title: Renegade Son
videos.overview: Cisco tries to prove a girl innocent of murder. Pancho: Leo Carrillo.

videos.title: False Marriage
videos.overview: Jasper King has asked his old friend Cisco to help him stop the marriage between his niece Nancy and the gangster Duke Ralston. Cisco and Pancho break the wedding ceremony and run away with the protesting bride. During a quarrel about this Duke kills Jasper. Nancy tells the sheriff that it is Cisco and Pancho who have killed her uncle. To prove their innocence Cisco and Pancho have to find the real murder and deliver him to the sheriff.

videos.title: Wedding Blackmail
videos.overview: Cisco and Pancho try to help a young bank teller, whose marriage to the bank president's daughter is endangered by two gunmen who are blackmailing him about a secret from his past.

videos.title: Lynching Story
videos.overview: When a bank president is murdered, the townspeople accuse the man's future son-in-law of the crime and a lynching party is formed. Cisco and Pancho must find out who the real killers are before the mob hangs the innocent man.

videos.title: Confession For Money
videos.overview: A young woman asks Cisco and Pancho to help her fiancée, who has confessed to a robbery and murder he didn't commit in order to get money for his mother's surgery.

videos.title: Haven For Heavies
videos.overview: Cisco follows the killer of a U.S. marshal to the town of Twin Buttes, which is notorious as a haven for criminals of all kinds.

videos.title: Uncle Disinherits Niece
videos.overview: Cisco aids a man suspected of murdering a rancher. Cisco: Duncan Renaldo. Pancho: Leo Carrillo.

videos.title: Water Rights
videos.overview: Cisco matches wits with an unscrupulous banker. Pancho: Leo Carrillo.

videos.title: Water Toll
videos.overview: Cisco and Pancho come to the aid of a lady rancher who's fighting a greedy cattle baron who's making ranchers and drovers pay him for watering their herds.

videos.title: Vigilante Story
videos.overview: In order to break up a gang of vigilantes that's terrorizing the people of Buffalo Flats, Cisco and Pancho head into town disguised as a gambler and an organ grinder.

videos.title: Hypnotist Murder
videos.overview: Cisco and Pancho intervene when a woman tries to get her husband and his rich father killed, while later, she gets blackmailed by a another woman.

videos.title: Robber Crow
videos.overview: Cisco and Pancho find themselves in the middle of a feud between the guards at a gold mine and the mine's workers, whom the guards suspect of stealing gold from the mine.

videos.title: Quarter Horse
videos.overview: Cisco takes part in an endurance race to help prove 4 quarter-horses can beat one thoroughbred, while the man entrusted to hold the race money, is planing to steal it.

videos.title: Ghost Town
videos.overview: Cisco and Pancho find a woman near death in the desert and learn she is a target for murder because she is headed for a ghost town to prove an inheritance and upon accompanying her find an addled innkeeper and other characters.

videos.title: Quicksilver Murder
videos.overview: A crooked prosecutor robs quicksilver shipments, then uses chemical weapons to commit murder. Cisco and Pancho investigate.

videos.title: Spanish Dagger
videos.overview: Cisco rescues an old prospector from a mine explosion. He discovers an ancient jeweled dagger that places a curse on anyone who steals it.

videos.title: The Puppeteer
videos.overview: Cisco and Poncho help the town of Peaceful Valley catch a gang of bank robbers who have been hitting all of the surrounding towns, but never Peaceful Valley.

videos.title: Laughing Badman
videos.overview: Cisco and Pancho must solve the murder of a deputy sheriff whose body they found on the trail with saddlebags stuffed with $50 bills.

videos.title: Gun Totin' Papa
videos.overview: After robbery in town, citizen picks up shotgun off street dropped by 'shotgun' miller after robbery. 'Papa' rides into town holding shotgun and is mistaken for the bandit. He escapes on his horse only to fall off and have to be rescued by Cisco and Pancho from a treacherous rock cliff. The sheriff and posses show up and throw all in jail. After members of Shotgun Miller's gang hear about this, they decide to break papa out of jail since he must know where the real papa is... Cisco and Pancho must then break out and rescue papa to clear their name.

videos.title: Bodyguard
videos.overview: Cisco and Pancho try to protect an old rancher who's carrying a sack full of money.

videos.title: Bullets and the Booby Trap
videos.overview: Cisco and Pancho enlist the aid of the grandson of a female denizen of a ghost town taken hostage by a gang of payroll robbers because the grandson has at the ready a system of numerous ingenious booby traps ready to subdue the gang.

videos.title: The Gramophone
videos.overview: Cisco and Pancho attempt to thwart a crooked rancher's plan to fool a local tribe into assisting him in preventing construction of a railroad line through land the rancher wants to use.

videos.title: Battle of Red Rock Pass
videos.overview: Cisco and Pancho offer their assistance to a toll road guard.

videos.title: Chinese Gold
videos.overview: Cisco and Pancho go after a masked bandit who's been robbing a community of Chinese miners.

videos.title: The Faded General
videos.overview: On the trail of outlaws, Cisco and Pancho are captured and held prisoner by an unstable ex-general.

videos.title: The Fugitive
videos.overview: While searching for a severely ill Mexican child, Cisco and Pancho uncover a plot by a rancher to contaminate land with disease-infected animals so he can buy it cheap.

videos.title: Outlaw's Gallery
videos.overview: Cisco and Pancho bait a trap for an outlaw gang plaguing a town.

videos.title: The Black Terror
videos.overview: In an attempt to round up two rival bands of outlaws, Cisco wears a black mask and goes undercover as The Black Terror.

videos.title: Sky Sign
videos.overview: While purchasing provisions at a country store, Cisco and Pancho encounter an outlaw gang lead by an escaped convict.

videos.title: Cisco Meets the Gorilla
videos.overview: A band of outlaws commits a series of robberies, while a sheriff and his deputy hunt down a gorilla on the loose.

videos.title: Not Guilty
videos.overview: Pancho's nephew is the witness to a murder and identifies the killer, who is arrested. When the circuit judge arrives for the trial, he is actually one of the killer's friends, who is impersonating the real judge in an effort to free his buddy.

videos.title: The Iron Mask
videos.overview: It's Cisco and Pancho to the rescue when outlaws abduct a sheriff and imprison the lawman in an iron mask.

videos.title: Double Deal
videos.overview: In order to exact revenge against Cisco for having once put him in jail, a man commits a gold shipment holdup while disguised as the Cisco Kid.

videos.title: Horseless Carriage
videos.overview: Pancho's nephew buys a new "horseless carriage", but finds himself in trouble when thieves use it as a getaway vehicle after they've robbed the bank.

videos.title: The Steel Plow
videos.overview: A blacksmith attempts to invent an iron plow to till the hard earth. Ranchers believe farmers are stealing cattle to survive. After Cisco is injured he sends Pancho to investigate.

videos.title: Powder Trail
videos.overview: Cisco tries to save a town from bankruptcy.

videos.title: Cisco Plays the Ghost
videos.overview: Cisco impersonates an apparition to trap a killer who is superstitious.

videos.title: A Six-Gun For No-Pain
videos.overview: Cisco and Pancho receive aid from a traveling dentist when they try to track down a notorious killer who's now posing as a cattle dealer.

videos.title: Three Suspects
videos.overview: Cisco tries to figure out which of three suspects is a robber. His only clue is a hat found near the scene of the crime.

videos.title: Juggler's Silver
videos.overview: A former circus juggler blames Cisco and Pancho for the worthless mine he recently purchased and tries to kill them.

videos.title: Young Blood
videos.overview: Cisco tries to keep a teenager out of an outlaw gang. Cisco: Duncan Renaldo. Pancho: Leo Carrillo.

videos.title: Man with the Reputation
videos.overview: Cisco is accused of helping an escaped convict. A gang has taken over a town, evicting residents who can't repay loans.

videos.title: Kilts and Sombreros
videos.overview: Cisco and Pancho rescue a kilt-clad Scotsman from bandits. Later he brags to his nephew that he once rode with the Cisco Kid.

videos.title: Tangled Trails
videos.overview: Cisco and Pancho try to find a girl's missing uncle.

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 1 nomination total
